_note: Native project hook configuration for the delegation observer. The canonical checkout is preferred when present; cloud checkouts use CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
command: if [ -d "${HOME}/carr-system/hooks" ]; then r="${HOME}/carr-system"; else r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; fi; if [ ! -e "$r/hooks/delegation-gate.py" ] && [ ! -L "$r/hooks/delegation-gate.py" ]; then printf '%s\n' "CARR HOOK WARNING: missing script $r/hooks/delegation-gate.py; skipping" >&2; exit 0; fi; exec /usr/bin/env python3 "$r/hooks/delegation-gate.py"

missing_script_policy._note: Shared hook classification. hook-command-selftest.py executes every template against these lists. Safety Stop hooks terminate immediately with a named error; the failure limit is one. Delegation is observation-only telemetry. Continuity, presence, machine setup and watchdog digests are optional.
